lore.description: Dog-sized, scorpion-like creatures, Drilltails were originally used by wildcatters who lacked the funding to employ larger drilling Xalians like the Frackworm. Drilltails use their small, stinger-like drills to quickly tunnel through the earth, darting in and out of the surface as they hunt for prey to ambush with their sharp, scissor-like claws.
appearance: Dog-sized scorpion-like body on many legs
Scissor-like pincer claws on the forelimbs
Segmented tail arched over the back, ending in a helical drill
lore.habits: It holds the haphazard wells and cavern networks that fortune-seekers drilled beneath the dunes, workings the Xalians who took them over still pump. It reads what moves overhead through the ground rather than by eye, and it wears a target down over repeated passes rather than settling it in one. Endessa's twin suns make the open surface lethal to cross, so it moves at the low hours or swims through loose particulate instead of walking on it. It signals by drumming through rock and sand, the only channel a shaft carries. The dunes cost heat and water, and its body gives up little of either.
lore.biomeNiche: the packed sand and deep cavern networks of Endessa's Nightcap wells

signatureAbility.name: Wildcatter Auger
signatureAbility.description: The Drilltail runs a shaft beneath its quarry and comes up under it drill first.
